caseName: Cleveland Hotel Protective Committee v. National City Bank
caseNameFull: Cleveland Hotel Protective Committee v. National City Bank of Cleveland, Successor Trustee
attorneys: Robert H. Jamison for petitioners., John T. Scott for the National City Bank, and /. Hall Kellogg for the Cleveland Terminals Building Co., respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy and Mr. Justice Burton took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
